personality_one_liner: A clear, highly legible, and reassuring medical companion that empowers elderly patients and caregivers without feeling geriatric.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing is critical for motor accessibility. Touch targets must not overlap. Add minimum 16px padding inside all cards, and 24px between distinct sections.

do's: Use solid colors instead of blur to maintain absolute maximum contrast for elderly users.
dont's: Do not use blur or transparency on elevated surfaces, as it reduces contrast and legibility.

screens.name: Início
screens.purpose: A clear daily hub showing today's immediate schedule (medications and appointments) and a quick action to log vitals.

states.loading: Centered loading spinner with 'Carregando agenda...' text (16px).
states.empty: Illustration of a clean calendar, 'Tudo tranquilo para hoje!' with a primary CTA to 'Adicionar Lembrete'.
states.error: Message 'Não foi possível carregar a agenda' with a large 'Tentar Novamente' button.

screens.layout: Top section: horizontal date strip (large numbers). Middle section: 'Today's Log' showing cards for scheduled medications (Green tag) and consultations (Blue tag) with large check/miss buttons. Bottom right: prominent FAB to log measurements.

screens.name: Calendário
screens.purpose: Monthly and weekly tracking of all health events using the specific color-coded label system.

states.empty: No events listed for the selected day.

screens.layout: Month calendar at the top with colored dots (Azul=Consulta, Verde=Medicamento, Roxo=Vacina, Laranja=Exame) indicating events. Selecting a day updates a list below showing the chronological agenda with large cards.

screens.name: Medicamentos
screens.purpose: Management of current prescriptions, adherence tracking, and refill reminders.

states.empty: Pill bottle image, 'Nenhum medicamento cadastrado', with large 'Adicionar Medicamento' CTA.

screens.layout: List view of active medications. Each card shows the drug name (18px), dosage (16px), and next time to take. Includes visual adherence rings or progress bars.

screens.name: Evolução
screens.purpose: Visualizes health metrics (BP, weight, glucose) over time to track progress and identify fall risks.

states.empty: Icon of a chart, 'Nenhum dado registrado', with CTA 'Registrar Sinais Vitais'.

screens.layout: Segmented control at the top to select metric (Pressão, Glicemia, Peso). Main area shows a line chart using Blue (Medical) and Green (Patient/Caregiver) lines. Below chart: historical log list.

screens.name: Perfil
screens.purpose: Caregiver and patient details, emergency contacts, and app settings.
screens.layout: Profile banner with patient/caregiver portrait. Large list rows (min 56px height) for Emergency Contacts, Doctors, Settings. High contrast text on all rows.

profile_banner_caregiver.alt: Portrait of a smiling active senior couple, representing caregiver and patient

medications_empty_state.alt: Clean minimalistic white pill bottle for medication empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use the provided hex codes for the light and dark theme as requested by the user, ignoring the general ban on blue/purple since the user explicitly provided brand hex codes.

Implement the font size scale accurately: Base body text MUST be minimum 16px (`base`), subtitles 18-22px (`lg` to `xl`), and titles 22-28px (`xl` to `2xl`). This is a hard requirement for elderly accessibility.

Primary call-to-action buttons MUST have a minimum height of 56px (`paddingVertical` ~16px with 16px text) and a border radius of 12-16px. Ensure touch targets for icon buttons are at least 48x48px using `hitSlop` or generous padding.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or blur effects. Solid colors (`surfaceSecondary` or `surfaceInverse`) must be used for elevated elements to maintain maximum contrast for elderly users.
Implement the exact color coding system for events: Consultation = Blue (#2563EB), Medication = Green (#16A34A), Vaccine = Purple (#9333EA), Exam = Orange (#EA580C).
Ensure dark mode support correctly inverts surfaces as specified in `dark_color_overrides`, maintaining WCAG AA contrast.
Use `lucide-react-native` for icons, combining outline and filled variants (e.g., filled for active tab, outline for inactive, as permitted).
